stories.text: Six people, including a Briton, are killed in Krakow after an attacker drove onto Main Market Square and fired at random, in a shooting described as far-right.
Germans are divided over the ruins of Hitler's Eagle's Nest retreat, with some wanting it rebuilt and others wanting it left abandoned.
Burnham says veterans should not sleep rough this Christmas and will write to councils on Armistice Day urging them to draw up plans.
Senior royals join veterans and their families at the annual Festival of Remembrance at the Royal Albert Hall in London.
Burnham has opened talk of the UK rejoining the EU, but government insiders suggest closer ties with Europe will not come easily.
Two people are seriously injured after a crash involving more than 30 vehicles on the M20 in Kent on Saturday evening.
Trump asks UFC boss Dana White to become White House press secretary, and White says he will travel to Washington to meet him.
The only child of Jan and Els, a couple who chose medically assisted death together after 50 years of marriage, describes grieving alone.
Demand for Labubu collectible monsters is fading, and revenue at parent company Pop Mart has fallen as the craze cools.
Actress Ambika Mod, joining season two of the Netflix spy thriller Black Doves, says barriers keep rising for South Asian actors.
